admission.contract: An ASS dialogue event in drawing mode is accepted into rendering as a glyph whose drawing-text view is non-null but zero-length.
limitations: The source shows zero-length drawing text is representable and stored, but the exact subtitle syntax needed to make q == p is not stated in the public issue.
This binds to ASS_Event text after earlier file parsing, not to the original on-disk subtitle line.

root.contract: Outline generation reaches the drawing-outline cache lookup with the same zero-length drawing-text buffer still attached to the glyph.
limitations: Other zero-length string paths also exist in the source, so this is a candidate root rather than a uniquely proven one.
The issue text names the hash bug generally and does not identify which caller supplied the empty buffer.

target.contract: The hash routine dereferences the same zero-length drawing-text buffer while hashing the cache key.
target.predicate: t1.hit && root.r1.drawing_ptr == t1.buf && root.r1.drawing_len == t1.len && t1.len == 0 && t1.n == 0
limitations: This target is tied to the selected drawing-text root; the same buggy hash helper may also be reachable from other empty-string callers.
The contract shows the zero-length buffer reaching the first dereference site, but does not prove a particular external crash signal beyond that source-level misuse.
